rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is naive, innocent, and readily trusting.

example.english: They are so ingenuous that they actually believe all those online free-gift ads.
example.traditional: 佢咁天真，竟然信晒網上啲免費贈品廣告。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 tin1 zan1 ging2 jin4 seon3 saai3 mong5 soeng6 di1 min5 fai3 zang6 ban2 gwong2 gou3

rows.note: Use this when someone is open and frank rather than naive or innocent.

example.english: I’ll be ingenuous with you: I don’t want to take this job anymore.
example.traditional: 我坦白同你講，我唔想再接呢份工作。
example.jyutping: ngo5 taan2 baak6 tung4 nei5 gong2 ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 zip3 ne1 fan6 gung1 zok3
